description:
Layan Lucky Villas is a luxurious residential complex consisting of 18 exclusive villas in two distinct layouts. Ideally located, the project is 20 minutes from Phuket International Airport and top international schools, and 10 minutes from Layan Beach.

The project is designed with a strong focus on functionality, security, and comfort, making it ideal for long-term living. Each villa offers a spacious layout that ensures privacy for every family member, while the outdoor areas provide multiple relaxation zones, allowing for a dynamic living experience without leaving home.

The villas are thoughtfully designed for maximum convenience. Each bedroom features a walk-in wardrobe with ample storage. There is also a spacious covered garage complemented by a separate laundry/storage area, a living room with pool and garden views, a dining area, an open-plan kitchen, and an outdoor lounge area. High-quality technical equipment is a priority, and each villa is ready for smart home system installation.

The villas feature multifunctional rooms that can be transformed into a home theater, office, gym, or spa.

The villas are located in a gated community with 24/7 security and modern systems. Even when you are far from home, you can always access the security cameras via your smartphone.

The complex is a small village surrounded by tropical nature, providing peace and privacy. The neighbors in this community are people who share similar values and lifestyles.

The villas are equipped with the latest technologies, including a Sonos audio system, high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property, wireless chargers, video intercom, and automated modern household appliances.

If you want to add a personal touch to your future home, a team of designers is at your service.

The price includes the villa, land plot, swimming pool, air conditioners, kitchen with built-in appliances, wardrobes, plumbing, integrated "Smart Home" system, and landscape design.

name: Layan — Tri Vananda · Villa · Nanda 3 · 3 bedroom
description:
Tri Vananda is a large residential project in Phuket focused on health and well-being, developed by Montara Hospitality Group, the owner and operator of the luxurious Trisara resort on Phuket.

Size: Tri Vananda spans across 96 hectares, with only 15% of the land being used for construction.

Sustainability: The project emphasizes sustainable development and integration with nature.

Main Feature: A Health Resort by the world-renowned Clinique La Prairie, specializing in integrative and functional medicine, cognitive health, and mental well-being. The resort will be equipped with consultation rooms, physiotherapy facilities, and traditional Chinese medicine clinics.

Other Amenities: The complex includes a meditation center, a spa with thermal zones, a fitness center with a 50-meter swimming pool, and a pier for water sports.

Restaurant: JAMPA, awarded the Green Michelin Star for its commitment to sustainability, offers dishes made from seasonal products grown on the project’s own farm or sourced from local producers.

Community Center: A venue for events and socializing among residents.

Children’s Space: Includes the Tweenie Club, designed for children aged 8 to 14, with opportunities for both learning and play.

Wellness Facilities: A swimming pool, a modern gym, and various wellness offerings to promote physical health and well-being.

Exclusive Access: Owners will also have access to the services and beach at the Trisara resort.

Customizable Villas: Residents can choose the location of their villa and customize the floor plan. Seven different villa layouts are available, ranging from 2 to 4 bedrooms and from 325 m² to 853 m² in size.

Phase 1 Villas: The first phase of Tri Vananda’s residential villas is available for investment. With the opening of the Health Resort by Clinique La Prairie in 2026, demand for these exclusive villas is expected to grow. By reserving a plot now, you can secure your participation in this exceptional project.

Proximity: Just 15 minutes from Phuket International Airport and a few minutes from pristine beaches, a marina, a national park, shopping malls, UWC International School, and a hospital.

Natural Surroundings: The project is surrounded by forests and lakes, harmoniously blending with nature, promoting a peaceful and healthy living environment.

On-site Wellness Services: Modern health and wellness facilities directly within the project.

Farming: Organic farming and educational programs for children.

Community: A community of like-minded individuals supporting healthy living and mutual assistance among residents.

Sustainability: An innovative approach with renewable energy sources and water purification systems.

Ideal Location: Close to nature yet conveniently located near urban amenities.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What sets this project apart is that the villas do not follow standard layouts but are built to custom designs. Within just 5 minutes, residents can reach Bang Tao Beach and access the resort’s extensive amenities.

The complex is located in the prestigious Laguna Phuket area, close to the beach, golf course, and the full infrastructure of the resort.

Residents can enjoy all the resort's amenities, including restaurants, shops, spas, fitness centers, and other services, with added privileges.

A shuttle bus regularly runs between the complex and the beach, restaurants, and shops.

24-hour security, management services, and technical support ensure comfort and safety.

Laguna Homes is set in a quiet, picturesque location where owners can enjoy privacy without sacrificing the conveniences of city life.

A unique, brand-new villa with 5 spacious bedrooms and a total area of 1300 sqm is available for resale.

First Floor: The master bedroom features a walk-in closet and additional access to the garden, where an outdoor bathroom with a shower and sauna is located. There is also a panoramic office on this floor.

Second Floor: The second master bedroom, a beauty space with a massage table, an open yoga zone with views of the golf course, a large gym, and a panoramic game area with a pool table and air hockey are all situated here.

The villa includes two kitchens, a barbecue area, and large wine refrigerators.

The villa’s grounds feature an 85 sqm pool, reinforced pond banks, and a wide walking promenade that runs along the perimeter of the house.

The house is equipped with premium appliances, including brands like Smeg, Liebherr, and Dyson, as well as a smart home system, automatic irrigation, electric vehicle charging station, and a spacious garage for two cars and a motorcycle.

The interior is finished with natural materials and is filled with modern art pieces. By purchasing this home, you’re not just acquiring property, but also a lifestyle, along with exclusive privileges as a resident of one of the most prestigious resorts in Asia.

Final settlement with the seller upon signing all agreements

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.

Purchasing property from a developer in Thailand is a process that requires attention to detail and adherence to legal procedures. Our specialists at Get Your Phuket are ready to guide you every step of the way, ensuring the safety and success of your transaction.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

What is the process for completing a property purchase from a developer in Phuket?

The process of purchasing property from a developer in Thailand can seem complex, especially if you are dealing with local legal procedures for the first time. However, by following a clear sequence of steps with a professional agency, you can safely and successfully acquire your new home or apartment in Phuket. Below are the main stages of this process.

Choosing the Right Property with an Independent Market Expert

The first step in purchasing real estate is selecting a property that meets your requirements and expectations. It is recommended to consult with an independent market expert who can help assess the prospects of various properties and provide up-to-date information about developers and the terms of the deal.

After choosing a property, you will proceed to sign a reservation agreement. It is important to carefully review the terms of the agreement, as it formalizes your intention to purchase the specific property. Along with signing the agreement, a deposit is required, the amount of which is set by the developer. Typically, the deposit ranges from 100,000 THB to 2% of the property price. This deposit confirms your commitment and ensures that the property you selected will be reserved for you.

Drafting, Reviewing, and Signing the Sales and Purchase Agreement

The next important step is the preparation of the main sales and purchase agreement. At this stage, the lawyers of both parties review the contract, making necessary changes and clarifications. Once everything is in order, the agreement is signed. This process can take up to 30 calendar days, depending on the conditions outlined in the reservation agreement. Signing the sales and purchase agreement legally solidifies the obligations of both parties and sets the stage for further payment actions.

After signing the main contract, it is time to make the first major payment, which usually ranges from 20% to 33% of the total property price. Further payments are made according to the schedule outlined in the reservation agreement. These can be either a lump sum payment or a series of regular payments during the construction phase.

Once the property is ready, the process of registering ownership begins. This procedure is usually handled by the developer and their legal team, although you can also appoint your independent lawyer to manage the registration. The registration process at the Land Department takes between 10 to 45 days. It is important to ensure that all documents are properly completed and registered.

After the ownership registration process is completed, you will receive a final bill for the remaining amount. Once full payment is made, you will receive documents confirming your ownership of the property. At this stage, you officially become the owner of your new home or apartment in Phuket.
